title: Premonition of the DC Metro red line fire
place_text: DC Metro red line, Washington DC

tellings.quote: on the 89th day um there was a fire fatal fire on the red line of the metro in DC

plain: Lou Elizondo, a well-known figure in the push for UFO disclosure, says he had a premonition linked to a count of days that he connects with the physicist Hal Puthoff. He says that on the 89th day there was a fatal fire on the red line of the Washington, DC metro, which he tells as a sign that such foresight can be real.
